implementation: canonical physical H/S/SWAP lift; SWAP=3 CNOT; CNOT=H_target CZ H_target; local H uses the frozen selective-GR/Rz echo construction on 8 live data atoms

NPJ2025_coherent_model.provenance: Chung et al., npj Quantum Information 11, 193 (2025)

timing_envelopes.parallel_Rz_layer: all same-angle site-addressed Rz requests in one compiler layer are simultaneous; no AOD switching latency added
timing_envelopes.serial_Rz_sites: site-addressed Rz pulse durations are summed; no AOD switching latency added

coherent_unitary_stress.model: apply ideal CZ, but replace every GR(theta) by GR(theta+0.0345) and every Rz(theta) by Rz(1.012 theta); repeat through the signed cycle period
coherent_unitary_stress.metric: 8-qubit average gate infidelity relative to identity/global phase
coherent_unitary_stress.profile_status: CROSS_PROFILE_STRESS because timing and coherent-error parameters originate from separately characterized public profiles

stochastic_exposure.CZ_survival: 0.9962^N_CZ under an explicitly independent-pair survival model
stochastic_exposure.Rz_leakage_envelope: (1-0.00066)^N_Rz using the PRX 2MHz single-qubit leakage characterization as a state-independent stress envelope
stochastic_exposure.GR_fidelity_product: 0.99980^N_GR diagnostic only; not a process composition theorem
stochastic_exposure.idle_diagnostic: cycle_time/T2star and exp(-cycle_time/T2star); the exponential is a diagnostic, not the measured Ramsey functional form

claim_rule: A motion survives the finite-pulse gate only if its ideal coherent suppression is not overwhelmed by the source-stress control infidelity and its timing/loss exposure remains Pareto-competitive. No hardware promotion follows.
